title: Post-Compaction Recovery Checklist
desc: After conversation compaction, reload critical project, browser, Claude, Codex, appbot approval, and runtime context before continuing. Use at the start of continuation sessions or whenever the assistant may have lost mid-session discoveries.
steps: SKILL COMMAND DISCIPLINE: Skills must be read and edited via wkappbot skill commands. If a .skill.json was edited directly, run wkappbot skill install --app <name> or wkappbot skill sync.

ACTIVE PROJECT STATE: Re-read repo-level handoff or memory files if present, then git status --short and git log --oneline -10. Treat existing dirty worktree changes as user/system-owned unless explicitly asked to revert.
OPEN WORK CONTEXT: Check active editor file, open tabs, recent ask artifacts, .wkappbot task files, and draft/output folders relevant to the current repo before continuing.

BROWSER/CDP STATE: If browser automation is relevant, run curl -s http://localhost:9222/json to verify CDP and identify the exact tab/window before eval-js. PIDs, hwnds, and tab IDs change after reboot.

APPBOT HEALTH STATE: Check key appbot health commands relevant to the task, such as wkappbot claude-usage, wkappbot eye tick, wkappbot skill read <needed-skill>, or wkappbot suggest list. If logs fail with UnauthorizedAccess, treat it as sandbox/log-write context first.
ACTIVE SKILLS: Re-read the task-specific appbot skills before acting. Prefer wkappbot skill search/read over raw .skill.json reads unless editing the skill itself.
DIRECT SKILL JSON EDIT RECOVERY: After direct .skill.json edits, run wkappbot skill install --app <name> or wkappbot skill sync so search/read sees the skill.

CLAUDE/CODEX HANDOFF: Immediately run wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff and follow it. Recover Claude JSONL context and Codex continuity from C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\session_index.jsonl plus C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\sessions when prior work may have been delegated.

CODEX GLOBAL CONFIG BASELINE: Re-check C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\config.toml after compaction. Expected model=gpt-5.4-mini, profiles worker/frontier/readonly, ask_for_approval=never, approval_policy=never, sandbox_mode=danger-full-access, trusted project entries for active repos.

APPBOT AUTO-ACCEPT BASELINE: Re-check C:\Users\kiexp\.codex\rules\default.rules for broad wkappbot and wkappbot-core prefix_rule allow entries, and verify WKAPPBOT_AUTO_APPROVE_ALL=1. If missing, restore before appbot-heavy commands.

CURRENT SANDBOX REALITY CHECK: Even if Codex config says danger-full-access, the current outer runtime may still be read-only. If wkappbot fails with UnauthorizedAccess on logs, rerun with escalated execution; do not misdiagnose it as WKAppBot logic failure.
REPORT AFTER RECOVERY: Summarize what was happening, what was left unfinished, current appbot/Codex approval state, and the next recommended action. Never dump raw JSONL or noisy logs.

SUGGEST WORK AND SKILL HEALING: When continuing after compaction, run wkappbot suggest list/show if suggest work is in scope. While handling suggest items, search/read related skills and immediately update any skill that is missing steps, stale commands, requirements, or generalized lessons discovered during the fix.
author: claude
